title: "Album Cover Similarity"
format:

    page-layout: full

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(DT)

pop_albums <- read_csv("pop_albums.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

album_catalog <- pop_albums |>
  mutate(
    hex_clean = sub("^#", "", hex_color),
    r = strtoi(substr(hex_clean, 1, 2), 16L) / 255,
    g = strtoi(substr(hex_clean, 3, 4), 16L) / 255,
    b_val = strtoi(substr(hex_clean, 5, 6), 16L) / 255,
    b_norm = brightness / 100,
    s_norm = saturation / 100,
    c_norm = contrast / 100
  ) |>
  transmute(
    id = row_number(),
    artist,
    album,
    year,
    cover = cover_full,
    thumb = cover_thumbnail,
    hex = hex_color,
    palette,
    r = round(r, 3),
    g = round(g, 3),
    b = round(b_val, 3),
    bright = round(b_norm, 3),
    sat = round(s_norm, 3),
    contrast = round(c_norm, 3)
  )

json_payload <- toJSON(album_catalog, auto_unbox = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: json-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

cat('<script type="application/json" id="album-similarity-data">\n')
cat(json_payload)
cat('\n</script>\n')
```

```{=html}
<div class="comparison-toolbar">
  <div class="toolbar-item" style="flex: 1.2; min-width: 220px;">
    <label class="toolbar-label" for="artist-picker">Artist</label>
    <select id="artist-picker" class="toolbar-select">
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="toolbar-item" style="flex: 1.8; min-width: 260px;">
    <label class="toolbar-label" for="album-picker">Album</label>
    <select id="album-picker" class="toolbar-select">
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="toolbar-item" style="min-width: 200px;">
    <label class="toolbar-label" for="metric-picker">Comparison Mode</label>
    <select id="metric-picker" class="toolbar-select">
      <option value="overall" selected>Color & Design</option>
      <option value="color">Color Palette Only</option>
      <option value="design">Spatial Design Only</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="toolbar-item">
    <button id="btn-surprise" class="btn-random" title="Select a random album from the 1,000+ catalog">
      <span>🎲</span> Surprise Me!
    </button>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="comparison-grid">
  <!-- Left Column: Selected Target Album -->
  <div id="selected-card" style="background: #ffffff; border: 2px solid #3b82f6; border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12); position: sticky; top: 20px;">
  </div>

  <!-- Right Column: Matches -->
  <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px;">
    <!-- Most Similar -->
    <div style="background: #f0fdf4; border: 1px solid #bbf7d0; border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px 20px;">
      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 14px;">
        <h4 style="margin: 0; color: #166534; font-size: 1.1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
          <span>🟢</span> Most Similar Album Covers
        </h4>
        <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #15803d; font-weight: 600;">Top Matches across 1,000+ Albums</span>
      </div>
      <div id="most-similar-cards" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 16px;">
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Least Similar -->
    <div style="background: #fef2f2; border: 1px solid #fecaca; border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px 20px;">
      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 14px;">
        <h4 style="margin: 0; color: #991b1b; font-size: 1.1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
          <span>🔴</span> Least Similar Album Covers
        </h4>
        <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #b91c1c; font-weight: 600;">Maximum Visual Contrast</span>
      </div>
      <div id="least-similar-cards" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 16px;">
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
function initAlbumComparison() {
  const dataElement = document.getElementById("album-similarity-data");
  if (!dataElement) return;
  const albumData = JSON.parse(dataElement.textContent);

  const artistPicker = document.getElementById("artist-picker");
  const albumPicker = document.getElementById("album-picker");
  const metricPicker = document.getElementById("metric-picker");
  const surpriseBtn = document.getElementById("btn-surprise");
  const selectedCard = document.getElementById("selected-card");
  const mostCards = document.getElementById("most-similar-cards");
  const leastCards = document.getElementById("least-similar-cards");

  if (!artistPicker || !albumPicker || !metricPicker || !selectedCard || !mostCards || !leastCards) return;

  const allArtists = Array.from(new Set(albumData.map(a => a.artist))).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  const featured = ["Taylor Swift", "Red Hot Chili Peppers", "Billie Eilish", "Harry Styles", "Bruno Mars", "Olivia Rodrigo", "Dua Lipa", "Ariana Grande", "Ed Sheeran", "Adele", "Michael Jackson"];
  
  artistPicker.innerHTML = "";
  
  const featuredGroup = document.createElement("optgroup");
  featuredGroup.label = "Featured Artists";
  featured.forEach(name => {
    if (allArtists.includes(name)) {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = name;
      opt.textContent = name;
      if (name === "Taylor Swift") opt.selected = true;
      featuredGroup.appendChild(opt);
    }
  });
  artistPicker.appendChild(featuredGroup);

  const allGroup = document.createElement("optgroup");
  allGroup.label = "All Artists (A-Z)";
  allArtists.forEach(name => {
    const opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = name;
    opt.textContent = name;
    allGroup.appendChild(opt);
  });
  artistPicker.appendChild(allGroup);

  function populateAlbumsForArtist(artistName, defaultAlbum) {
    albumPicker.innerHTML = "";
    const list = albumData.filter(a => a.artist === artistName);
    list.forEach((item, idx) => {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = item.album;
      opt.textContent = item.album;
      if (defaultAlbum ? item.album === defaultAlbum : idx === 0) {
        opt.selected = true;
      }
      albumPicker.appendChild(opt);
    });
  }

  function selectAlbumByName(artistName, albumName) {
    artistPicker.value = artistName;
    populateAlbumsForArtist(artistName, albumName);
    updateDisplay();
  }

  function renderCard(item, metric, isMatch) {
    let scoreText = "";
    if (metric === "color") {
      scoreText = `Color: ${(item.colorSim * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
    } else if (metric === "design") {
      scoreText = `Design: ${(item.designSim * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
    } else {
      scoreText = `Match: ${(item.overallSim * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
    }

    const badgeBg = isMatch ? "#dcfce7" : "#fee2e2";
    const badgeColor = isMatch ? "#15803d" : "#b91c1c";

    return `
      <div class="match-card" onclick="window.selectAlbumByName('${item.artist.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}', '${item.album.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">
        <img src="${item.cover}" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='${item.thumb}'" style="width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1/1; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; display: block;" alt="${item.album}"/>
        <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 10px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: #0f172a;" title="${item.album}">${item.album}</div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.78rem; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 8px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;">${item.artist} (${item.year})</div>
        <div style="display: inline-block; background: ${badgeBg}; color: ${badgeColor}; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 12px;">
          ${scoreText}
        </div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.7rem; color: #94a3b8; margin-top: 6px;">
          Color: ${(item.colorSim * 100).toFixed(0)}% | Design: ${(item.designSim * 100).toFixed(0)}%
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function updateDisplay() {
    const artistName = artistPicker.value;
    const albumName = albumPicker.value;
    const metric = metricPicker.value;
    
    const target = albumData.find(a => a.artist === artistName && a.album === albumName);
    if (!target) return;

    selectedCard.innerHTML = `
      <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 800; color: #2563eb; letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-bottom: 8px; text-align: center;">Selected Album</div>
      <img src="${target.cover}" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='${target.thumb}'" style="width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1/1; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; display: block;" alt="${target.album}"/>
      <h3 style="margin: 14px 0 4px 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; text-align: center;">${target.album}</h3>
      <div style="font-size: 0.95rem; color: #64748b; font-weight: 500; text-align: center;">${target.artist} &bull; ${target.year}</div>

      <!-- Extracted Visual DNA / Color Swatch -->
      <div style="margin-top: 14px; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px;">
        <div style="font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 6px;">Visual Profile</div>
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px;">
          <span style="display:inline-block; width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:4px; background:${target.hex}; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);"></span>
          <span style="font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #1e293b;">${target.palette}</span>
          <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94a3b8; font-family: monospace;">${target.hex}</span>
        </div>
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.76rem; color: #475569; padding-top: 6px; border-top: 1px dashed #e2e8f0;">
          <span>Brightness: <strong>${(target.bright * 100).toFixed(0)}%</strong></span>
          <span>Vibrancy: <strong>${(target.sat * 100).toFixed(0)}%</strong></span>
          <span>Contrast: <strong>${(target.contrast * 100).toFixed(0)}%</strong></span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top: 12px; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #64748b; text-align: center;">
        💡 <em>Click any similar cover on the right to analyze it</em>
      </div>
    `;

    const candidates = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < albumData.length; i++) {
      const a = albumData[i];
      if (a.id === target.id) continue;

      const dColor = Math.sqrt(
        Math.pow(a.r - target.r, 2) +
        Math.pow(a.g - target.g, 2) +
        Math.pow(a.b - target.b, 2) +
        Math.pow(a.sat - target.sat, 2)
      ) / 2.0;
      const colorSim = Math.max(0, 1 - dColor);

      const dDesign = Math.sqrt(
        Math.pow(a.bright - target.bright, 2) +
        Math.pow(a.contrast - target.contrast, 2)
      ) / 1.414;
      const designSim = Math.max(0, 1 - dDesign);

      const overallSim = 0.5 * colorSim + 0.5 * designSim;

      candidates.push({
        ...a,
        colorSim,
        designSim,
        overallSim
      });
    }

    if (metric === "color") {
      candidates.sort((x, y) => y.colorSim - x.colorSim);
    } else if (metric === "design") {
      candidates.sort((x, y) => y.designSim - x.designSim);
    } else {
      candidates.sort((x, y) => y.overallSim - x.overallSim);
    }

    const mostList = candidates.slice(0, 3);
    const leastList = candidates.slice(-3).reverse();

    mostCards.innerHTML = mostList.map(item => renderCard(item, metric, true)).join("");
    leastCards.innerHTML = leastList.map(item => renderCard(item, metric, false)).join("");
  }

  // Expose selectAlbumByName globally so card click handlers can call it
  window.selectAlbumByName = selectAlbumByName;

  artistPicker.addEventListener("change", function() {
    populateAlbumsForArtist(artistPicker.value);
    updateDisplay();
  });

  albumPicker.addEventListener("change", updateDisplay);
  metricPicker.addEventListener("change", updateDisplay);

  // Surprise Me Button
  if (surpriseBtn) {
    surpriseBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
      const randomAlbum = albumData[Math.floor(Math.random() * albumData.length)];
      selectAlbumByName(randomAlbum.artist, randomAlbum.album);
    });
  }

  populateAlbumsForArtist("Taylor Swift", "Lover");
  updateDisplay();
}

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initAlbumComparison);
} else {
  initAlbumComparison();
}
</script>
```

## All Albums Catalog (1,000+ Covers)

```{r}
#| label: table
#| echo: false

pop_albums |>
  mutate(
    Cover = sprintf('<img src="%s" width="45" height="45" style="border-radius: 4px; object-fit: cover;" alt="%s" loading="lazy"/>', cover_thumbnail, album),
    Color = sprintf('<span style="display:inline-block; width:18px; height:18px; background-color:%s; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:3px; vertical-align:middle;" title="%s"></span>', hex_color, hex_color)
  ) |>
  select(Cover, Color, Artist = artist, Album = album, Year = year, Genre = genre, Palette = palette) |>
  datatable(
    options = list(pageLength = 10, searchHighlight = TRUE),
    escape = FALSE,
    rownames = FALSE
  )
```
